title: 7.5 Factoring x² + bx + c

icans: I can factor x² + bx + c when c is positive.
I can factor x² + bx + c when c is negative.
I can solve equations and real-life problems by factoring.

vocab: __________ it as (x + p)(x + q), where p + q = b and pq = c
c > 0: p and q have the same sign as b.  c < 0: p and q have ___________ signs; the larger one has the sign of b

notes: Factoring x² + bx + c: x² + bx + c = (x + p)(x + q), where p · q = ______ and p + q = ______.
